findings.description: Directory enumeration: both list pages downloaded (page 0 and page 1 of the department-filtered directory). 45 person cards parsed (30 on page 0 plus 15 on page 1), names matching the 45 brief people exactly with no omissions in either direction; every directory_entry_id slug matches its card.

The directory has no separate emeritus, joint/secondary or affiliate list. Every category was read from the individual card rank lines (and profile pages where cited); emeritus status appears only in Bruce Smith's card and profile.

No announced incoming appointment was visible on any card or on the seven profiles fetched, so no record has incoming status or an announced start date. News and announcement pages were not searched; effective_from_json is null for all records.

Brief expected_primary_profile_urls lists the directory without the www host. The brief lists URL (with www) was fetched exactly and returned 200 with no redirect; both are the same directory query. Page 1 was fetched at the brief URL with &page=1 appended.

Optional profile pages were fetched for the seven people whose card rank was ambiguous (Ferat Sahin, Karl Hirschman, Jayanti Venkataraman, Sarah McCale, Bruce Smith, Santosh Kurinec, Alireza Vahid). All seven returned 200. Other decisions rest on the card rank line, which states the title directly. Membership for excluded records denotes the unit listing (ece = EME listing, outside_ece = Dean's Office with no EE appointment) and is not an inclusion determination.

Karl Hirschman: included as regular, membership ece. Card rank line is 'Associate Department Head, Microelectronic Engineering' with no professorial rank word. Profile (kdhemc) bio states he is a 'professor in the department of electrical and microelectronic engineering' -> regular. Borderline: decision rests on the profile's professorial-rank statement; the card title alone would not establish rank.

Sarah McCale: excluded as adjunct, membership ece. Card rank line 'Academic Advisor' (Dean's Office) with tag 'Adjunct Faculty'; profile (skmiao) lists the same and a co-op course EEEE-499. The only EE-related role is adjunct -> excluded (adjunct). Borderline only on which role controls; both are non-professorial.

Ferat Sahin: included as regular, membership ece. Card shows 'Department Head' with department 'Dean's Office' and no rank word. Profile (feseee) bio: 'he is a Professor and Department Head of Electrical and Microelectronics Engineering department'. Department head with professorial rank in EME -> regular. Borderline: card and profile place the headship differently (Dean's Office vs EME); decision uses the profile's specific professorial statement.

Bruce Smith: excluded as emeritus, membership ece. Card lines: 'Adjunct' (EME department) and 'Distinguished Professor Emeritus'; profile (bwsemc) repeats both. Emeritus status is the specific official status -> excluded (emeritus), current_state past. Adjunct would give the same exclusion. No retired/emeritus list exists on the directory.

Alireza Vahid: included as regular, membership ece. Card rank 'Gleason Memorial Professor' (EME) with secondary 'Gleason Endowed Professor'; profile (arveme) repeats the same title. Named professorship in EME -> regular. Borderline: no separate 'Professor' rank word; the endowed professorship is treated as professorial rank.

Jayanti Venkataraman: excluded as academic_professional, membership ece. Card rank 'Associate Department Head, Electrical Engineering' with no professorial rank. Profile (jnveee) has no professorial rank in its title, bio, or education; administrator title without professorial appointment -> academic_professional. Borderline: would become included (regular) if an official source states professorial rank.
